audit_items.proof_trace: The piecewise formula is continuous at both kink points by algebraic construction: at util_rate=mid_kink the low segment yields weight=1 giving exactly borrow_rate_on_mid_kink, while the mid segment yields weight=0 also giving exactly borrow_rate_on_mid_kink; likewise at util_rate=high_kink both the mid and high segments evaluate to borrow_rate_on_high_kink. The boundary conditions use `float::ge` (>=) so exact kink values fall in the lower segment, but this does not cause a discontinuity because both segments are algebraically identical at the boundary. The included unit tests (lines 123–158) confirm the absence of any rate jump at the 40% and 80% kink points.
